text.p: Italy booked a place in the quarter-finals of the European basketball championship on Sunday with a hard fought 63-60 win over Spain.
Despite the result, the hosts will almost certainly also go through to the last eight, as will Yugoslavia, who beat Germany 88-73.

Spain looked set to continue their unbeaten run after opening a 36-25 lead at halftime. Italy fought back in the second term, and after seeing Alfonso Reyes foul out, the home side gave up a crucial loss of possession with 50 seconds on the clock which decided the game.
Yugoslavia's win left 1993 champions Germany in danger of elimination having lost three out of four games.
In other games Turkey trailed 26-35 at halftime but came out strongly after the break to outscore a nervous Israeli side 17-1, and went on to take the game 81-71.
France were left close to elimination after losing 93-80 to Russia.
